proposals.before: King Wei laughed: "If the master gets drunk after a single peck, how could he possibly drink a whole bushel?
proposals.after: King Wei said: "If the master gets drunk after a single peck, how could he possibly drink a whole bushel?
proposals.reason: Chinese 威王曰 is 'said', not 'laughed'; the idiomatic rendering invents laughter absent from the source.

proposals.before: At this, King Zhuang apologized to You Meng. He summoned the son of Sun Shuao and enfeoffed him with four hundred households at Qinqiu, so that the ancestral sacrifices might be maintained.
proposals.after: At this, King Zhuang thanked You Meng. He summoned the son of Sun Shuao and enfeoffed him with four hundred households at Qinqiu, so that the ancestral sacrifices might be maintained.
proposals.reason: Chinese 謝優孟 here is thanks after the remonstrance, not an apology; the literal already translates 謝 as thanked.

proposals.before: The nurse's children, grandchildren, and household servants ran rampant through Chang'an. They blocked the roads, dragged people from their carts, and stripped the clothes from their backs.
proposals.after: The nurse's children, grandchildren, slaves, and attendants ran rampant through Chang'an. They blocked the roads, dragged people from their carts, and stripped the clothes from their backs.
proposals.reason: The Chinese 奴從者 distinguishes slaves and attendants; the idiomatic rendering collapses them into household servants and drops 奴.

proposals.before: It took two men from the Office of the Public Carriage just to lift the memorial, and even then they could barely carry it.
proposals.after: The Director of the Public Carriage had two men lift the memorial together, and even then they could barely carry it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 公車令 names the Director of the Public Carriage as the official who assigned two men to lift the memorial; the idiomatic version drops that office-holder and treats the office as the actor.

proposals.before: As the general was leaving the palace, a man from Qi named Dongguo Xiansheng — who had been waiting as a specialist scholar at the Office of the Public Carriage — stepped into the road and blocked the general's carriage. He bowed and said: "I wish to offer a word of counsel."
proposals.after: As the general was leaving the palace, a man from Qi named Dongguo Xiansheng — who had been waiting as a fangshi at the Office of the Public Carriage — stepped into the road and blocked the general's carriage. He bowed and said: "I wish to offer a word of counsel."
proposals.reason: Fangshi (方士) is a master of recipes or esoterica, not a generic specialist scholar.

proposals.before: As the general was leaving the palace gate, a man from Qi named Dongguo Xiansheng, who had been waiting as a specialist scholar at the Office of the Public Carriage, blocked the general's carriage in the road, bowed and said: "I wish to present a matter to you."
proposals.after: As the general was leaving the palace gate, a man from Qi named Dongguo Xiansheng, who had been waiting as a fangshi at the Office of the Public Carriage, blocked the general's carriage in the road, bowed and said: "I wish to present a matter to you."
proposals.reason: Same fangshi mistranslation in the literal English.

proposals.before: When the governor was finally called in to kneel before the emperor.
proposals.after: When the governor was finally called in, he knelt and bowed before the emperor.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English is an incomplete subordinate clause and omits the completed act of kneeling and bowing present in the Chinese 入跪拜.

proposals.before: He proposed to send the court clerk and one of the local magnates into the river to hurry them along.
proposals.after: He proposed to send the district clerk and one of the local magnates into the river to hurry them along.
proposals.reason: 廷掾 is the county/district clerk of Ye, not an imperial court clerk; the idiomatic rendering already uses district clerk.

proposals.before: They proposed to consolidate the waterways, merging every three canals into a single channel where they crossed the highway.
proposals.after: They proposed to consolidate the waterways, merging every three canals into a single bridge where they crossed the highway.
proposals.reason: 合三渠為一橋 refers to one bridge spanning the merged crossing, not a single channel; the literal already has bridge.

decisions.reason: 威王曰 records King Wei speaking, not laughing; the idiomatic laugh is invented.
After the remonstrance, 莊王謝優孟 is thanks to You Meng, not an apology; 謝 here does not mean he confessed fault to the jester.
乳母家子孫奴從者 lists descendants plus 奴 and 從者; 'household servants' drops the slaves and collapses two groups.
公車令 is the Director of the Public Carriage who had two men jointly lift the memorial; the original makes anonymous office men the actors and drops 令.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 公車令兩人共持舉其書

decisions.reason: 以方士待詔公車 identifies Dongguo as a fangshi awaiting summons, not a generic specialist scholar.
The same 方士 in the literal English is a fangshi, not a specialist scholar.
太守入跪拜 is a complete act of entering, kneeling, and bowing; the original is a sentence fragment and omits 拜.
廷掾 is Ye's district clerk, not an imperial court clerk; 'court clerk' misidentifies the office.
合三渠為一橋 is one bridge at the highway crossing, not a single channel; 橋 is omitted by 'channel'.
